record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, scale each history-item embedding by a fixed training-frequency feature: clamp((median_positive_count/count[item])^0.25, 0.5, 2.0), using counts solely from training interactions and scale 1 for unseen items. Keep padding zero and candidate embeddings unchanged. This may prevent common history items from dominating recurrent updates. Preserve embedding parameters, GRU topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer; persist the scales and reproduce them through the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Test fixed training-frequency scaling of history embeddings across all four categories. Counts use training interactions only; unseen items retain scale 1 and padding stays zero. Candidate embeddings, learned parameters, GRU, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged. The registered buffer is saved in each category checkpoint and restored by the generated predictor, which imports the updated model class.
